name: Pimozide
aliases: haldol decanoate, Orap®, Pimozida, Pimozidum, R-6238
summary: Pimozide, sold under the brand name Orap, is a typical antipsychotic medication of the diphenylbutylpiperidine class. It was discovered at Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1963. It is indicated for use in Tourette syndrome and resistant tics. It has a high potency compared to chlorpromazine (ratio 50–70:1). On a weight basis it is even more potent than haloperidol.

pharmacology.text: Pimozide acts as an antagonist of the D2, D3, and D4 receptors and the 5-HT7 receptor. It is also a hERG blocker. Similarly to other typical antipsychotics pimozide has a high affinity for the dopamine D2 receptor and this likely results in its sexual (due to prolactin hypersecretion) and extrapyramidal side effects as well as its therapeutic efficacy against the positive symptoms of schizophrenia.

uses.text: Pimozide is used for Tourette syndrome, and resistant tics (Europe, United States, and Canada) and in Europe for schizophrenia, chronic psychosis, delusional disorder, and paranoid personality disorder.

summaryZh: 雙氟苯丁哌啶苯並咪唑酮是二苯丁基哌啶類的抗精神病藥藥品。它於1963年由楊森製藥公司所研發。與氯丙嗪相比具有高效力（比例50-70：1）。在重量基礎上，它比氟哌啶醇更有效。對於妥瑞症及耐藥性抽動綜合症，哌迷清還具有特殊的神經系統適應功效。
summaryZhHans: 双氟苯丁哌啶苯并咪唑酮是二苯丁基哌啶类的抗精神病药药品。它于1963年由杨森制药公司所研发。与氯丙嗪相比具有高效力（比例50-70：1）。在重量基础上，它比氟哌啶醇更有效。对于妥瑞症及耐药性抽动综合症，哌迷清还具有特殊的神经系统适应功效。

sideEffects.en: Like other older antipsychotics it commonly causes stiffness, tremor and restlessness, along with drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, which is lasting involuntary movements, and there is a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity. It can also lengthen the heart's QT interval, so heart tracings are usually checked.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他舊式抗精神病藥一樣，它常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖與躁動不安，並伴隨嗜睡與站起時頭暈。長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，也就是持久的不自主動作，另有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。它也可能延長心臟的 QT 間期，因此通常會進行心電圖檢查。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他旧式抗精神病药一样，它常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖与躁动不安，并伴随嗜睡与站起时头晕。长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，也就是持久的不自主动作，另有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。它也可能延长心脏的 QT 间期，因此通常会进行心电图检查。

fact.en: Pimozide was discovered at Janssen in 1963 and is one of the few medicines used for Tourette syndrome. It is also known for occasionally helping a rare delusion about infestation by parasites.
fact.zh: 匹莫齊特在 1963 年由楊森公司發現，是少數用於妥瑞症的藥物之一。它也以偶爾能改善一種罕見的寄生蟲感染妄想而知名。
fact.zhHans: 匹莫齐特在 1963 年由杨森公司发现，是少数用于妥瑞症的药物之一。它也以偶尔能改善一种罕见的寄生虫感染妄想而知名。
